2146-2363-4659-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Cloud Key, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-5233-8338.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Shuttlecraft Galileo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2105-3603-6968-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3603-6968-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3603-6968-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

222-527-3967-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1575-4231-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1575-4231-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1257-4300-7857.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1257-4300-7857.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Walking Atlas.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.

1987-3277-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3277-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3277-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1636-5316-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-5316-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Tura Kennerüd triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3850-5929.description: Activate Realmbreaker's second ability by paying {10}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search for all creatures in your library, as they are all Praetors due to Leyline of Transformation, and put them onto the battlefield.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1753-3259-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
1753-3259-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1753-3259-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Samut so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

1491-6218-6723-7315.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

454-1978-7308.description:
Cause Mona Lisa to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat from step 2.

3169-4050-4484-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
3169-4050-4484-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1318-2743-2959.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Heat Shimmer twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Heat Shimmer spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with seven or more loyalty counters

193-1180-2247-6802.notablePrerequisites: You control three creatures that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
193-1180-2247-6802.description:
Activate Nicol Bolas using Dovin's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using at least three creatures, triggering Nicol Bolas that many times, putting that many loyalty counters on it.
Activate Aminatou's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
During your next turn, activate Nicol Bolas using Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Nicol Bolas, causing it to re-enter the battlefield with four loyalty counters on it.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 once.
Repeat from step 1 during your next turn.
193-1180-2247-6802.notes: This combo requires a turn of setup before getting infinite turns. If you are able to activate Teferi or Nicol Bolas for infinite turns, you may do so to get around this. he number of counters on Nicol Bolas to start can be reduced depending how many creatures you control that can deal combat damage to an opponent.

222-527-4785-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.

222-527-4785-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2425-3967-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2425-3967-6249--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

813-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
813-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Scholar of the Ages, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

121-3765-6102.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
121-3765-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
121-3765-6102.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

1115-2457-4289-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2558-2921-4848-5687.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Domri, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1069-1879-3228-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1879-3228-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

2792-3967-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2792-3967-5140.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

791-3693-5872.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-5872.description:
Activate Taii Wakeen by paying at least {2} and tapping it.
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing at least 3 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain at least 3 life.
Repeat from step 3.

191-1689-5435.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
191-1689-5435.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

338-678-2060-2606-5256.notablePrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-678-2060-2606-5256.description:
Cast Pelakka Wurm by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Pelakka Wurm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain 7 life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting seven +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Pelakka Wurm.
When Pelakka Wurm dies, its second ability and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Pelakka Wurm trigger, causing you to reveal the top card of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Pelakka Wurm from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Pelakka Wurm's power.
Repeat.

152-549-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {8}.
152-549-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {8}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Great Whale with haste.
The token Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.

624-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
624-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying {1}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Palinchron.
Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Phantasmal Image by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

654-1257-1671-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Walking Atlas.
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
654-1257-1671-4222.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

1300-2816-2826.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four other Shrines.
1300-2816-2826.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability.
Resolve the copy of Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

262-366-1218.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Purphoros.
Purphoros does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least five devotion to red.
262-366-1218.description:
Cast Tainted Strike, giving Purphoros +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Purphoros by tapping it, creating a number of Elemental tokens with haste equal to Purphoros's power.
The tokens enter, triggering Purphoros seven times.
Resolve each trigger giving each opponent fourteen poison counters.

313-586-2034.description:
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Priest of Gix triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Sacrifice Priest of Gix to Ashnod's Altar adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2896-5276.description:
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, exiling Necromancy.
Necromancy leaves the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice Leonin Relic-Warder.
Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, returning Necromancy from exile to the battlefield.
Necromancy enters the battlefield, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Repeat from step 3.

45-614-1518-1987.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
45-614-1518-1987.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
